---
title: Rich annotation items
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'quarto-annotation-item\("annotated-cell-1", 1, \['
          - 'First paragraph'
          - 'Second paragraph'
          - 'nested'
          - 'code span'
          - 'https://example\.org'
          - 'x\^2'
        -
          - 'quarto-code-annotations:'
---

```{.python}
x = 1  # <1>
```

    Second paragraph with math $$x^2$$.
